content.comment_body: [product_name] [version_no] loses its clock when powered off. Is there a way to make the clock persistent?

I've used a [product_name] [version_no] since December 2022. There isn't a setting to prevent the real-time clock from losing time and date. The device uses a super capacitor to retain these values for up to 20 days without power. How long is your device connected to power before it is turned off?
I understand. Maybe the initial power-on time was too short. I'll experiment further. Thank you!

analysis.insight_summary: Users indicate that the [product_name] [version_no] loses its real-time clock data when power is disconnected, which could affect operations requiring precise timing. The device relies on a super capacitor to retain the clock for about 20 days during power outage, but a sufficiently long initial power-on is necessary to ensure proper charging. There is no configuration to keep the clock settings permanently after extended power loss.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want the [product_name] [version_no] to retain its real-time clock settings across power outages, providing persistent clock data regardless of how long the device remains without power.
